verifier_cases.quote: shall complete the interconnection study for a small storage resource within thirty (30) business days
verifier_cases.source_text_override: Study completion.  Each electric utility shall complete the interconnection study for a small storage resource within thirty (30) business days of the date of the “complete application” — as that term is defined in Rule 3.2(a). The utility shall deliver the written study results to the applicant within three (3) business days of completing the study.
